description: Figure 2 illustrates the performance of several methods across varying chunk sizes. The x-axis is labeled “Chunk Size” and has a linear scale ranging from 8 to 128, with tick labels at intervals of 8, and units are not specified. The y-axis is labeled “Retrieval Accuracy (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 20 to 45, with tick labels at intervals of 5. There are five lines displayed: a solid blue line representing BM25, which begins at approximately 26.5% at a chunk size of 8 and increases to approximately 31.4% at a chunk size of 128; a solid orange line representing GIIST, which begins at approximately 26.5% at a chunk size of 8 and increases to approximately 31.6% at a chunk size of 128; a solid green line representing GPT-4, which begins at approximately 35.4% at a chunk size of 8 and increases to approximately 41.8% at a chunk size of 128; a dashed purple line representing RAG, which begins at approximately 32.4% at a chunk size of 8 and increases to approximately 41.6% at a chunk size of 128; and a dashed red line representing RepEval, which begins at approximately 30.5% at a chunk size of 8 and increases to approximately 33.5% at a chunk size of 128.
